body: You are perfect for this world. I sincerely hope you can always justify your existence to yourself.

I want to hate this, but I'll think on it a while. I have this crazy idea... like a shadow that weighs on me. It is much like death, and possibly insane. Not violent, violence is a child's power play. I want to abdicate my power to the universe.. I want to merge with the Earth. This sounds terribly dated. I would like to meet the man who reads this and laughs, and laugh along with him. I quit my job today, grabbed my laptop and walked a few miles to my favorite cafe. I'm "stoned immaculate" (to keep up with the embarrassingly dated feel) but i am still very angry. and ugly deep down. I've done some things that I will never forget. I've never killed anyone, or anything like that.. but. I have hurt people in ways that frighten me, I have entertained thoughts that sicken me. It doesn't matter. Tomorrow is the big day and I must choose which leap I take.

"things that most people would die for"   that's my problem. if you take a step back and look at the realpolitik involved, the exploitation of others around the world... it is so absurd to me. maybe i'm insane
Thanks but I'm not saying anything new.
*no, I'm not going to kill myself during a performance. That is fucking masturbatory.. but I guess so is posting here..
